evidence.intree_statement: Program Definition Kleisli : Category := {| obj := C; hom := fun x y => x ~> M y; homset := fun x y => @homset C x (M y); id := @ret C M _; compose := fun x y z f g => join ∘ fmap[M] f ∘ g |}. (objects = obj C; a Kleisli arrow x~>y is a C-arrow x ~> M y; id = ret = eta; g♯o f♯ = mu_z o T g o f)
Program Definition Kleisli_Free : C ⟶ Kleisli := {| fobj := fun x => x; fmap := fun x y f => ret ∘ f |}. (F_T: identity on objects, k |-> (eta_y o k)♯)
Program Definition Kleisli_Forget : Kleisli ⟶ C := {| fobj := fun x => M x; fmap := fun x y f => join ∘ fmap[M] f |}. (G_T: x |-> T x, f♯ |-> mu_y o T f; so G_T F_T x = T x)

Program Definition Kleisli_Adjunction : Kleisli_Free ⊣ Kleisli_Forget := @Build_Adjunction' Kleisli C Kleisli_Free Kleisli_Forget Kleisli_adj_iso _ _. (transpose f♯ <-> f is the identity map on the shared setoid x ~> M y)
Lemma Kleisli_unit_agrees {x : C} : @unit _ _ _ _ Kleisli_Adjunction x ≈ ret[M]. Proof. reflexivity. Qed. (adjunction unit = eta)
Lemma Kleisli_counit_agrees {x : C} : @counit _ _ _ _ Kleisli_Adjunction x ≈ id[M x]. (counit at y_T is (1_{Ty})♯)

Theorem Kleisli_Monad_agrees : Kleisli_Forget ◯ Kleisli_Free ≈ M. (the induced monad's endofunctor U_M o F_M is M, with identity iso components; Kleisli_join_agrees at line 146 gives its multiplication = join = mu)

statement_record.book: For a monad <T,eta,mu> in X the Kleisli category X_T has an object x_T per x, an arrow f♯:x_T->y_T per X-arrow f:x->Ty, composition g♯ o f♯ = (mu_z o Tg o f)♯; functors F_T:X->X_T (k|->(eta_y o k)♯) and G_T:X_T->X (f♯|->mu_y o Tf, G_T F_T x = Tx) form an adjunction F_T|-G_T whose induced monad is the original, with unit eta and counit (1_{Ty})♯.
statement_record.intree: Kleisli (Monad/Kleisli.v:38) has obj=C, hom x y = x ~> M y, id=ret, compose = join o fmap f o g; Kleisli_Free/Kleisli_Forget/Kleisli_Adjunction (Monad/Kleisli/Adjunction.v) give F_M |- U_M with F_M x = x, U_M x = M x; Kleisli_unit_agrees (unit=ret), Kleisli_counit_agrees (counit=id[M x]), Kleisli_Monad_agrees (U_M o F_M = M) and Kleisli_join_agrees (mu=join) recover the original monad.
